Subject: Pre-offer approval request — SRE Lead (Erik Johansson)

Hi team,

Quick summary from the loop: Erik Johansson completed on-site loop yesterday (SRE depth, systems design, incident leadership). Interviewers gave consistent green feedback — strong production experience at scale, excellent incident postmortem discipline, and clear leadership instincts. Panel recommends leveling at Senior/Staff-equivalent (we're recommending L5 / Senior SRE).

Proposed comp package (initial recommendation):
- Base: $210,000 — $230,000 (target $220k)
- Bonus: 15% target
- Equity: 0.5% — 0.8% (1x vesting cadence discussion may apply)
- Start: AS-AP/30-45 days (candidate is currently interviewing other firms)

Attachments: candidate packet + comp memo (comp_memo_v3.docx).

Ask: Can I get signoff to proceed to formal offer at the mid-point of the range ($220k base, 0.6% equity) or, if you prefer, indicate any band-exceptions we should route to compensation committee now? I want to get verbal ok today so Talent can prepare the offer and DocuSign route.

Relevant notes: candidate has strong AWS infra background, wants manager-level growth in next 18 months; expects a total comp in-line with market for SF Bay Area.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference
